title: Owners can add a door machine today, but the address it is told to call does not exist, so it never comes online
what: Settings > Entry machines is open to every gym on the live panel, because its database part is live. The owner adds a finger or face machine by serial number and is told to set the machine's server address to gate.mettleup.fit, with 'It shows Online within a minute'. That address has no live service: the door service was never put live and the address does not even resolve. The machine stays 'not seen yet' for good, no member is let in by it, and the screen never says why. The 'not ready for your gym yet' message only shows when the database part is missing, which it no longer is.
expected: While the door service is not live, the screen says entry machines are coming soon and offers no add button; or the door service is put live first, then the screen opens.
who: gym owners who buy or own an eSSL or ZKTeco door machine
how_often: every time an owner adds a machine
fix_line: Hide adding a machine until the door service is live, or put the door service live first

title: Switching on the Pro pack lock today would lock nothing, because its database part is not live
what: The Pro pack lock (Starter gyms see 'Part of the Pro pack' on Branding, Shop, Challenges and the rest) is off on main. When it is switched on, the panel asks the database which pack the gym is on. That question is not in the live database, and on no answer the panel opens every feature on purpose. So flipping the switch alone would change nothing, and nothing would say so; the website already sells those features as Pro only.
expected: The plan to switch the Pro lock on names the database part it needs, and that part goes live first; or the feature list says 'waits for a database change', not only 'behind switch'.
who: the owner, when he decides to charge Starter and Pro differently
fix_line: Put the pack database part live before the lock is switched on, and note it in the feature list
